meta.title: Romy Alvarez Fernandez
meta.subtitle: Building enterprise web experiences at scale

paragraphs: Front-End Engineer with over 12 years of experience building large-scale digital platforms in enterprise environments. Specialized in CMS-driven architectures, modular component systems, and API integration.

I have led teams as Principal Front-End Developer, defining technical standards, guiding release workflows, and mentoring developers. My approach combines pixel-perfect quality, WCAG accessibility, SEO, and performance.
I work with AEM, Sitecore, and Drupal — with transferable knowledge to headless platforms such as Contentful, Strapi, and Sanity.

bullets: Development and customization of AEM components, dialogs, and templates for enterprise web applications.
Styling with HTML5, CSS3 (SASS/LESS), and JavaScript ES6+, ensuring responsive and accessible layouts.
Implementation of animations using JavaScript, GSAP, and Framer Motion.
Translation of Figma / Adobe XD designs into reusable and scalable front-end components.
Ensures compliance with WCAG, SEO, and cross-browser standards.
Coordination with QA and backend teams to validate component and API integrations.
Led front-end architecture across CMS platforms including AEM, Sitecore, Drupal, and ReactJS projects.
Standardized master templates to improve production efficiency at scale.
Defined release workflows, Git strategies, and conducted code reviews.
Collaborated with clients on requirements gathering and project estimations.
Mentored and guided junior developers through onboarding and best practices.
Developed responsive enterprise websites using AEM and Sitecore with reusable component architectures.
Collaborated with SEO teams to ensure technical optimization and metadata implementation.
Guaranteed accessibility compliance, cross-browser compatibility, and responsive design.
Provided technical mentorship and support to content authors.
Developed and integrated responsive web applications for global pharmaceutical clients.
Migrated legacy HTML sites to responsive frameworks (Bootstrap, Foundation).
Worked on Veeva iRep applications and website migrations.
Integrated external services and supported CMS migrations ensuring compliance with brand guidelines.
